questions.question: When Jesus heard that Lazarus was sick, what did He say the sickness was for?

answers.text: The glory of God and His Son
A test of the sisters' trust
A lesson for the whole village

questions.question: Jesus loved Lazarus and his sisters. After hearing that Lazarus was sick, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: Stayed where He was for two days
Left for Bethany that same hour

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples that Lazarus had fallen asleep. What was He really talking about?
When Jesus decided to return to Judea, where people had tried to stone Him, what did Thomas say?

answers.text: Let us also go so that we may die with Him
Let us stay here until it is safe to travel
Let us send word to the sisters before we go
